messages:
maria-ops: Starting a follow-up thread from the ACME Dedicated postmortem. We need to finalize owners + timelines for the VPC peering/on-prem isolation fixes and track recurring patterns. Can each owner confirm?

inc-bot: Incident report (INC-2026-042): https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042 — initial postmortem posted.

dave-sre: I'll own the peering route flapping investigation and the immediate guardrails. Plan: 1) short-term: automate peering health check + alert (2d) 2) mid-term: failover route policy (2w) 3) long-term: formal runbook + test harness (6w).

lee-eng: For on-prem constraints (KV cache invalidation during node restarts) I'll take ownership. Deliverables: reproduce with smaller cluster (this week), add graceful drain to runtime (2w), update deployment docs for customers (3w).

sophie-cs: I'll handle customer communication and timelines for ACME. ETA to customer for interim mitigation steps: EOD tomorrow.

raj-platform: Noted. I'll add autoscaling throttle to Dedicated pools to avoid large concurrent restarts — action: implement burst-smoothing (1w). Also will wire a metric for concurrent node restarts.

alice-ps: From a PS perspective, we need a checklist for on-prem installs: network MTU, peering keepalive, and control-plane firewall ports. I'll draft and share a template by Friday.

dave-sre: Quick FYI — discovered a subtle ordering bug in the peering reconciliation code that can cause stale routes to persist after controller restart. Short patch ready, will open PR and request review today.

lee-eng: If PR lands, we should run the regression harness against ACME's config before deploying. Can QA schedule a targeted run?

sophie-cs: I'll coordinate with ACME QA. If we plan a canary deploy to their staging, they'd like a 48h window.

maria-ops: Good. Let's capture these as action items with owners + due dates. Also we should track recurrence pattern: this is the third isolation-related outage tied to peering during high ops churn in the last 6 months. Propose recurring monthly triage to detect pattern regressions. Agree?

dave-sre: Agree. Monthly triage + a short SLA of <30min for peering alerts.

raj-platform: I'll add a dashboard tile that shows peering recon errors + restart bursts and an alert group for oncall.

alice-ps: For the runbook, suggest including a quick rollback plan and the exact commands we ran during the incident. Example snippet: ```kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets 
# wait for KV cache warmup
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | grep ok```

lee-eng: Noted — I'll paste the debug commands from the incident into the runbook once PR merges.

maria-ops: Scheduling: weekly check-in for action progress on Wednesdays at 10am until all items closed. First check-in encoded for next Wed. Also tagging owners in the postmortem doc.

sophie-cs: I'll send calendar invites to ACME stakeholders for the canary window once dates lock.

dave-sre: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/peering/merge_requests/1234. Patch fixes reconciliation ordering and adds unit tests. Requesting review from @lee-eng and @raj-platform.

raj-platform: Reviewing today. If green, I'll prepare a canary rollout plan to avoid pushing to all Dedicated clusters at once.

maria-ops: Final ask — everyone add a single-line status update to the postmortem doc before EOD Friday. We'll mark owners as: 
- Peering fix: dave-sre (PR + canary)
- On-prem KV drain: lee-eng (repro + patch)
- Autoscale smoothing: raj-platform (metric + throttle)
- Customer comms: sophie-cs (interim guidance)
- PS checklist: alice-ps (template)

inc-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled (calendar) and postmortem doc link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-042

maria-ops: Thanks all — short, focused items. We'll close this thread once the weekly check shows green on metrics and docs are updated. :thumbsup:
